shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git log --stat | head -30; head -c 600 package-lock.json
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls uikit/build/esm/components/theme/; sed -n 1,200p uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; ls uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls tabs; cat tabs/index.d.ts; cat tabs/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "export" ../../../build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -80
cat tabs/Tab.js | head -80; ls ../../../../icons/ | head; ls ../../../../icons/ | grep -iE "^(Sun|Moon|House|Gear|Circle-?Info|Person)" | head -20; head -20 Card/Card.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && ls | grep -E "^Sun|^ListCheck|^Flag" | grep d.ts; cat ../uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts | head -20; sed -n 1,40p ../uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | grep -n variant
rm -rf dist; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -1
